name: Epictetus
q: Let silence be your goal for the most part
No great thing is created suddenly
You are an actor in a play; the choice of the cast is not yours
No one is free who is not master of himself
People are disturbed not by things, but by their opinions about things
Say what you would be, then do it
Some things are up to us, and some are not
Wish things to happen as they do
Sickness is a hindrance to the body, but not to the will
There is only one way to freedom: to make light of what is not in our power
If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish
No one can hurt you without your consent
Death is not terrible; thinking so is
